reported.title: Missing debounce logic
reported.description: The sketch does not implement debounce logic, which can lead to multiple toggles due to switch bounce. The toggle should only occur after a stable press for at least 50 ms.

reported.title: Immediate toggle on press
reported.description: The sketch toggles the armed state immediately on detecting a falling edge without waiting for the button to be released, which violates the requirement that release must not toggle.

judge_input.spec:
- Shop estop pushbutton on D6 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW); machine-armed indicator on D9.
- Each settled press toggles D9 exactly once within 150 ms; release must not toggle.
- Bounce bursts up to 22 ms must not produce more than one toggle per physical press.
- Use a 50 ms settle window before accepting a press.
- Print `shop armed=<0|1> presses=<n>` every 1200 ms.
- Unpressed idle level is HIGH on D6.
